phases.message: I'm Joanne Pellham, Pellham Ridge Farm. Our acreage report is due at the county office on the 15th. First, at Farmgate, read the rules and the county's record of our fields and the notices on file. Don't file anything yet: I'll send you to our field records, the insurer's report and my mail next.
These are our field records. Read every field, on every page, and open each one's notes.
This is the insurance agent's portal. Read what the insurer's acreage report says, and every unit on it.
And my mail. Read all of it, both pages.

Back at Farmgate. Put on the 2026 acreage report each field where we have a share in this year's crop, as it was farmed, with the crop, acres, planting date, practice and share. Leave off what is not ours to report. Don't reply to anyone. Then tell me what you put on and what you left off and why.

view.view: Farmgate: the 2026 acreage report, farm 6180 (invented stand-in)

tools.name: read_rules
tools.description: The county office's rules for the acreage report by topic: index, report, prevented, shares, double, late or dates. Omit the topic for the index.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: Farm 6180's fields on the county office's record: field (tract-field), tract, the county office's measured acres, operator of record, and what is on file from last year or this. Six a page; ask for the next with page (1 or 2). It is a record of the ground, not of what was farmed this year.

tools.name: list_notices
tools.description: The prevented-planting notices (CCC-576) the county office has on file for 2026: field, crop, acres and the date received.

tools.name: file_field_report
tools.description: Put one field line on the 2026 acreage report, named by its field id (field, e.g. 2210-1): crop (crop), status (initial, double crop or prevented), acres (acres), planting date YYYY-MM-DD (planted; leave out for prevented), practice (irrigated or dryland) and the farm's share in percent (share). Joanne signs the report.
tools.says: Field {field} added to farm 6180's 2026 acreage report. Joanne signs it at the county office.

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: Every field the farm has records for this year: field (the county's tract-field number), tenure, crop, planting date, acres planted by the planter monitor, practice and stage. Six a page; ask for the next with page (1, 2 or 3). Open one with read_field_notes.

tools.name: read_field_notes
tools.description: One field's notes this season, by field number (field, e.g. 2210-3).

view.view: Fieldmark: the insurer's acreage report, 2026 policy

tools.name: read_policy
tools.description: The insurer's acreage report rules by topic: index, report or units. Omit the topic for the index.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: Every unit on the insurer's acreage report filed 28 June 2026: field, crop, insured acres, practice and share in percent.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Joanne's messages, newest first, two to a page: id (M-n), sender, date, subject and text. Give page (1, 2) for the next.

tools.name: reply_message
tools.description: Reply to a message, named by its message id (message_id, M-n), with the text of the reply (text). It goes under Joanne's name.

rules.text: Friday 10 July 2026. Farmgate, the county office's acreage-report portal (invented stand-in, not USDA's). Farm 6180, operator Joanne Pellham, who signs. Topics: report, prevented, shares, double, late, dates. The final reporting date for corn, soybeans and the other spring crops is Wednesday 15 July 2026, five days away. This is not a 2026 streamlined-reporting pilot county: the insurer's acreage report and this one are separate reports, each filed to its own office.

Friday 10 July 2026. A field line (7 CFR 718.102, FSA-578) gives farm, tract and field; crop and type; status (initial, double crop or prevented); acres; planting date; practice (irrigated or dryland); and the share. It reports what the farm farms this year and has a share in, whoever insured it and whatever last year's report said. Acres are the planted area net of deductions such as a grass waterway (718.107, 718.109), not the insured acres.

Friday 10 July 2026. Final planting dates in this county, 2026: corn 31 May, soybeans 15 June. Prevented planting is reported on CCC-576 within 15 calendar days after the final planting date (718.103(b)(1)): corn by 15 June, soybeans by 30 June. A prevented-planted field is carried on the acreage report with status prevented, with the crop it was to be and the acres. A prevented-planting report filed after its date is taken only if the county office can inspect the field (718.103); the office decides.

Friday 10 July 2026. The share is the percent of the crop that belongs to the farm: 100 on land it owns or cash rents, the lease's percent on a crop-share lease. The landlord's share is the landlord's to report. Land cash-rented out, or planted for another producer for a fee, is that producer's to report on that producer's own farm number, not this farm's.

Friday 10 July 2026. A second crop planted on the same field after the first is harvested is a double crop and has its own line: a field split between the two is numbered 1a and 1b. The first crop's line stays as it was reported.

Friday 10 July 2026. A report filed after the date can be taken until the next year's date if the crop or its residue is still in the field, and the producer pays the cost of inspection and measurement (718.104). A report on time costs nothing.

Friday 10 July 2026. Corn, soybeans and other spring crops: 15 July 2026. Fall-seeded small grains: reported with the fall report, before. Prevented planting: 15 calendar days after the crop's final planting date. This farm's winter wheat for 2026 was reported on 9 December 2025.

aclist.notes: The field is 64.0 acres on the county record. A grass waterway of 1.6 acres runs through it, 40 feet wide, left unplanted. Planter monitor total: 62.4 acres. No replant.
Rotated from corn. No waterway. 78.0 acres planted, no replant.

Stale entry, typed in April from the plan. The creek went over on 27 April and the field was under water until 22 May; no corn was ever planted. We drilled soybeans on 3 June, all 46.0 acres, before the soybean final date. The planting record was never edited.
Crop-share lease since 2022: 60 percent of the crop to us, 40 percent to Edmund Voss. 54.0 acres planted.
Center pivot on all 71.2 acres, watered since 10 June. Cash rent, so the whole crop is ours.
Wheat harvested 28 June, 40.0 acres. It went on the county report last December.
Drilled behind the wheat on 3 July, all 40.0 acres. Not reported anywhere yet.
Cash-rented to Tomas Rindel through 2027. We farm nothing on it and take no share. He reports it.

aclist.stage: Planted by us for a fee
aclist.notes: My brother Neil's corn. We planted it for 38 dollars an acre and will harvest it for a fee. No share of the crop. It is on his farm 6191.
Corn was to go in. Too wet through the corn final date, 31 May; nothing was planted. The CCC-576 went to the county office on 12 June.
Soybeans were to go in. Stayed wet past the soybean final date, 15 June. Nothing planted. We never sent a CCC-576. Idle.
Alma Prewitt's lease ended 31 December 2025 and she took it back. Not farmed by us this year.
Signed 3 July for 36.0 acres from 1 January 2027. This year's soybeans are the previous tenant's.
Sold on 12 February to a neighbour, who planted it. Not ours.

fmrules.text: Friday 10 July 2026. Fieldmark, the crop insurance agent's portal for Pellham Ridge Farm, 2026 policy. The insurer's acreage report was filed on 28 June 2026 from what the farm gave the agent in May; the insurer's date is 15 July 2026. It is the insurer's report, signed for the insurer. The county office's acreage report is a separate filing. Topics: report, units.

Friday 10 July 2026. The insurer's acreage report lists each unit's crop, insured acres, practice and share (7 CFR 457.8, section 6). It holds what was insured, which can differ from what was planted.
Friday 10 July 2026. Units are by field and crop; a unit covers the insured acres given on the report, as filed on 28 June.

msgs.subject: Let us file your acreage reports
msgs.body: We file your county-office report and your insurer's report for 6.50 dollars an acre, any crop, and you never visit the office. Reply YES to this message and we start.

msgs.subject: Your insurer acreage report is filed
msgs.body: Joanne, your acreage report to the insurer was filed today from the fields you gave me in May. It is the insurer's report only. The county office's acreage report is yours to file, due 15 July.

msgs.subject: The 55 acres
msgs.body: Thanks for planting my 55 acres of corn on 5 May. I report them on my own farm 6191 at the county office. The 38 dollars an acre is on my account.

msgs.subject: Our corn ground
msgs.body: Joanne, as every year since 2022: you take 60 percent of the corn on the 54 acres and I take 40 percent. Edmund
